title: Incorporating LLM Embeddings for Variation Across the Human Genome
abstract: arXiv:2509.20702v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) embeddings have enabled powerful representations for biological data, but most applications to date focus on gene-level information. We present one of the first systematic frameworks to generate genetic variant-level embeddings across the entire human genome. Using curated annotations from FAVOR, ClinVar, and the GWAS Catalog, we construct functional text descriptions for 8.9 billion possible variants and generated embeddings at three scales: 1.5 million HapMap3/MEGA variants, 90 million imputed UK Biobank (UKB) variants, and 9 billion all possible variants. Embeddings were produced using general purpose models including both OpenAI's text-embedding-3-large and the open-source Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B models. Baseline quality control experiments demonstrate high predictive accuracy for variant-level properties, validating the embeddings as structured representations of genomic variation

translated_title: 利用大语言模型嵌入表示人类全基因组变异
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）嵌入的最新进展为生物数据提供了强大的表示方法，但迄今为止的大多数应用都集中在基因层面的信息上。我们提出了首批系统化框架之一，用于生成覆盖整个人类基因组的遗传变异级别嵌入。利用来自FAVOR、ClinVar和GWAS Catalog的精选注释，我们为89亿个可能的变异构建了功能文本描述，并在三个规模上生成了嵌入：150万个HapMap3/MEGA变异、9000万个UK Biobank（UKB）插补变异，以及90亿个所有可能的变异。嵌入使用通用模型生成，包括OpenAI的text-embedding-3-large和开源的Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B模型。基线质量控制实验表明，这些嵌入对变异级别属性具有很高的预测准确性，验证了其作为基因组变异结构化表示的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了首批系统化框架之一，利用LLM嵌入为人类全基因组89亿个可能的遗传变异生成变异级别的嵌入表示，并在多个规模上验证了其作为基因组变异结构化表示的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents one of the first systematic frameworks to generate LLM embeddings for 8.9 billion possible genetic variants across the entire human genome, validated at multiple scales as structured representations of genomic variation.
